Definition: properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced)
BiblicalUsage: adj; 1) only, only one, solitary, one; 1a) only, unique, one; 1b) solitary; 1c)(TWOT) only begotten son; subst; 2) one
